items.title: Overview of Relational Databases and SQL Structure (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Overview of Relational Databases and SQL Structure (PDF 58, printed 54), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Relational databases data ko rows aur columns wale tables mein rakhte hain. Har table mutalliq data ko munazzam tareeqe se rakhta hai. Tables ke darmiyan rishte (relationships) keys ke zariye qaim rehte hain. SQL ka matlab Structured Query Language hai; yeh databases se baat cheet ke liye istemal hoti hai. SQL commands data banane, parhne, badalne aur mitane mein madad deti hain.

items: Relational database tables mein data, keys se rishte.
SQL (Structured Query Language) se data banate, parhte, badalte aur mitate hain.
